payload.reason: The evidence provides a detailed description of the architecture of the span detector within the Stochastic Answer Network (SAN).

claims.text: The span detector is part of the Stochastic Answer Network (SAN) architecture, which includes a multi-turn answer module.
The architecture of the span detector consists of a lexicon encoding layer, a contextual layer, and a memory generation layer, which are shared with the binary classifier.
The memory generation layer fuses information from passages and questions using attention mechanisms and BiLSTM to form the final memory for the span detector.
